name: nGZSceneGraph::cTextureImage::cTextureImage (ctor, thiscall kind; ret 4)
notes: SG_TextureImageSlots (1500 seeds: each side makes its texture with its own factory, kind 4 or 6, then 4-33 random calls over every slot against device, COM, image, resource-service and manipulator fakes, the device down one seed in five; the fakes' state and the heap compared after each call). Lane SJ, M4a part 4. Sets kind, zero fields, asks the director's COM for the device texture of class 0xbb892198 (kind 4) or 0xe944343d (kind 6), iid cITextureBase. In effect through callers: the factories 0xab4e50 / 0xab4d30 are hooked and make our object; the game's vtable 0xe766c4 is referenced only by the ctor and dtor. Mutants (tools/mutate.py, 22 over the class: the ctor's cube class, the dtor's image release, QI's third iid, Release's count, Restore's ready check / width-height order / upload / resource flag / key word, ReleaseResource's ready check, Load's levels and its slot-3 call, SetImage's key clear, GetImage's al test / group check / second key, Upload's normal-map kinds / level loop / occlusion flag, Create's cube width and 2D pool): 21 killed; the survivor (Upload's cube entry `<` to `<=` in a min) is equivalent. Not yet tested in-game.
